title: 第23章 招律师助理首先要会打第24章 法律是现代武功
slug: 律师霸凌者无罪我送他死刑
content_zh:
林默这个办公室很小，几乎就是一个一居室，推开门就能看见。
入眼的是一个长相甜美身材娇小的女人。
不过她身上穿著深蓝色的道袍，扎著一个道教经典“混元髻”，背著一把长剑。
妥妥的一副道士模样。
两颗小眼睛看著林默，嘴角扬起一个小小的弧度，明明长得很可爱，但透露出一丝狡黠。
林默眯了眯眼睛，好傢伙，现在上门看风水卖符咒符水的骗子都这么卷了。
以前还是年纪大的，现在都流行这种甜美系美女道士了吗？
至於道士来求自己打官司，这种可能性比较低。
於是林默一口气说道：“对不起，我的律师不需要看风水，也不需要符咒，也不需要驱魔，我也不信鬼神。”
女道士愣了一下，低头看了一下自己的一身道袍。
然后大大咧咧的解释道：“哦，你误会了，我不是来推销业务的。”
“那你是？”
女道士挺了挺身子，整理了一下著装：“我是来应聘律师助理的！”
“嗯？”这下倒是林默露出迷惑的表情了。
“等等，你来面试律师助理？你確定你是看我的招聘视频来的？”
女道士什么都算了，也有可能是cos，道士学法学什么的也能理解。
但是林默確幸自己发布的视频明確標註了，具有高强的格斗实力，需要充当保鏢。
眼前这个长相甜美的妹子，身高大概168左右，体重100斤左右，被匪徒一拳就能干趴下。
確定是看了自己的视频来的？
“视频？”妹子摇了摇头，然后真诚道：“我看到有一间律所，所以就进来问问，我已经大四了需要实习。”

好吧，看来是路过就来问问。
算了，既然人家都来了，就面试一下吧，反正瞎哥目前还没过来。
“那你先坐，说说你的情况吧。”
林默还倒了一杯水。
女孩大大咧咧的坐下，东看西看，不客气的拿起林默给的水一口喝了道：“我叫夏灵，来自南方政法大学，目前大四，校辩论队成员，大三，大二假期会去法院实习.......”
夏灵说的很详细，除了她这一身道士打扮，就是一个优秀的法学生。
学歷，实力经歷都很不错，司法考试考试已经通过，毕业就能申请办证。
南方政法大学在这个世界也是国內一流的法学院。
就这个女孩的履歷来自己这里都算是屈才了，她完全可以进红圈所的。
而且，自己招人可不是看这些指標。
“怎么样，简歷不错吧，我可没撒谎，这些都是真的，能不能招我当律师助理？”
“我很好养活的，一个月给两千就行。”
夏灵笑著露出一个虎牙，伸出两个指头。
林默笑了笑，这妹子还真不跟自己客气。
本来想要拒绝，但林默瞟了一眼她背上的剑，还是问道。
“你会不会打架？”
“打架？”夏灵或许是察觉到了林默看自己背著的剑。
她有些尷尬，立马用手挡了挡剑：“我可不会打架，我是一个遵纪守法的好公民，我今天这个装扮是角色扮演！”
“哦？”
content_en:
Lin Mo's office is very small, almost like a one-bedroom apartment. You can see it when you open the door.
What caught his eye was a sweet-looking woman with a petite figure.
However, she was wearing a dark blue Taoist robe, a classic Taoist "Hunyuan bun", and was carrying a long sword.
He looks like a Taoist priest.
Two small eyes looked at Lin Mo, and the corners of his mouth raised a small arc. He was obviously very cute, but there was a hint of cunning.
Lin Mo squinted his eyes. Good guy, now all the scammers who come to see Feng Shui and sell talismans are like this.
I used to be older, but now are these sweet and beautiful Taoist priests popular?
As for Taoist priests asking for a lawsuit, the possibility is relatively low.
So Lin Mo said in one breath: "I'm sorry, my lawyer doesn't need Feng Shui, he doesn't need spells, he doesn't need to exorcise demons, and I don't believe in ghosts and gods."
The female Taoist priest was stunned for a moment and looked down at her robe.
Then he explained carelessly: "Oh, you misunderstood, I'm not here to promote business."
"Then you are?"
The female Taoist priest straightened up and adjusted her clothes: "I'm here to apply for a job as a paralegal!"
"Huh?" Lin Mo looked confused this time.
"Wait, you're here to interview a paralegal? Are you sure you came here after watching my recruitment video?"
Female Taoist priests don't care about anything, they may be cosplayers, Taoist priests can understand if they study law or something.
But Lin Mo was indeed lucky that the video he posted clearly stated that he had high fighting ability and needed to act as a bodyguard.
The sweet-looking girl in front of me is about 16cm tall and weighs about 100 pounds. She can be knocked down by a gangster with just one punch.
Are you sure you came here after watching your own video?
"Video?" The girl shook her head, and then said sincerely: "I saw a law firm, so I came in to ask. I am already a senior and need an internship."
Well, it seems I was just passing by and asked.
Forget it, since everyone is here, let's do an interview. Anyway, the blind brother hasn't come yet.
"Then sit down first and talk about your situation."
Lin Mo also poured a glass of water.
The girl sat down carelessly, looking around. She politely picked up the water Lin Mo gave her and drank it in one sip: "My name is Xia Ling. I come from Southern University of Political Science and Law. I am currently a senior and a member of the school debate team. I am a junior and will go to the court for an internship during my sophomore holiday..."
Xia Ling said in detail that apart from her Taoist priest attire, she was an excellent law student.
I have good academic qualifications and experience. I have passed the judicial examination and can apply for a certificate after graduation.
Southern University of Political Science and Law is also one of the top law schools in the country.
Based on this girl's resume, I can consider her to be a talentless one. She can definitely enter the red circle.
Moreover, when you recruit people yourself, you don’t just look at these indicators.
"How about it? Your resume is pretty good. I didn't lie. It's all true. Can you hire me as a paralegal?"
"I can make a living easily. Just give me two thousand a month."
Xia Ling smiled, showing a tiger tooth and extending two fingers.
Lin Mo smiled, this girl was really not polite to him.
She originally wanted to refuse, but Lin Mo glanced at the sword on her back and asked anyway.
"Can you fight?"
"Fight?" Xia Ling may have noticed that Lin Mo was looking at the sword on his back.
She was a little embarrassed and immediately blocked the sword with her hand: "I don't know how to fight. I am a good and law-abiding citizen. My costume today is a role play!"
"Oh?"
